db:insert.doc:name: Insert New Product
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO products (sku, product_name, category_code, brand, price, currency, tax_class, stock_status, product_status, short_description, image_path, content_hash, source_updated_at, last_run_id, review_hold) VALUES (:sku, :productName, :categoryCode, :brand, :price, :currency, :taxClass, :stockStatus, :productStatus, :shortDescription, :imagePath, :contentHash, :sourceUpdatedAt, :runId, FALSE)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ sku: vars.currentSku, productName: payload.productName, categoryCode: payload.categoryCode, brand: payload.brand, price: payload.price as Number, currency: payload.currency, taxClass: payload.taxClass, stockStatus: payload.stockStatus, productStatus: payload.productStatus, shortDescription: payload.shortDescription, imagePath: payload.imagePath, contentHash: vars.computedHash, sourceUpdatedAt: payload.updatedAt default null, runId: vars.runId }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert New Product History
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO product_change_history (run_id, sku, change_type, field_name, new_value, customer_facing) VALUES (:runId, :sku, 'NEW', 'ALL', 'NEW_PRODUCT', TRUE)

db:update.doc:name: Update Changed Product
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE products SET product_name = :productName, category_code = :categoryCode, brand = :brand, price = :price, currency = :currency, tax_class = :taxClass, stock_status = :stockStatus, product_status = :productStatus, short_description = :shortDescription, image_path = :imagePath, content_hash = :contentHash, source_updated_at = :sourceUpdatedAt, last_run_id = :runId, review_hold = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sku = :sku
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ sku: vars.currentSku, productName: payload.productName, categoryCode: payload.categoryCode, brand: payload.brand, price: payload.price as Number, currency: payload.currency, taxClass: payload.taxClass, stockStatus: payload.stockStatus, productStatus: payload.productStatus, shortDescription: payload.shortDescription, imagePath: payload.imagePath, contentHash: vars.computedHash, sourceUpdatedAt: payload.updatedAt default null, runId: vars.runId }]

ee:transform.doc:name: Map Diffs to History Rows â€” calls map-history-records.dwl

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var runId = vars.runId default "RUN-DEFAULT" var sku = vars.currentRecord.sku default "UNKNOWN" var changeType = vars.deltaClassification.classification default "CHANGED" --- vars.deltaClassification.diffs map ((diff) -> { run_id: runId, sku: sku, change_type: changeType, field_name: diff.fieldName, old_value: if (diff.oldValue != null) (diff.oldValue as String) else null, new_value: if (diff.newValue != null) (diff.newValue as String) else null, customer_facing: diff.customerFacing default false })

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Field History
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO product_change_history (run_id, sku, change_type, field_name, old_value, new_value, customer_facing) VALUES (:runId, :sku, :changeType, :fieldName, :oldValue, :newValue, :customerFacing)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ runId: payload.run_id, sku: payload.sku, changeType: payload.change_type, fieldName: payload.field_name, oldValue: payload.old_value, newValue: payload.new_value, customerFacing: payload.customer_facing }]

db:update.doc:name: Flag Review Hold On Product
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE products SET review_hold = TRUE, last_run_id = :runId, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sku = :sku

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Price Guard History Row
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO product_change_history (run_id, sku, change_type, field_name, old_value, new_value, customer_facing) VALUES (:runId, :sku, 'HOLD_FOR_REVIEW', 'price', :oldVal, :newVal, FALSE)

db:select.doc:name: Find Absent Active Products
db:select.db:sql: SELECT sku, category_code FROM products WHERE product_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (last_run_id IS NULL OR last_run_id != :runId)

db:update.doc:name: Mark Products Delisted
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE products SET product_status = 'DELISTED', last_run_id = :runId, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (last_run_id IS NULL OR last_run_id != :runId)

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Delisted History Row
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO product_change_history (run_id, sku, change_type, field_name, old_value, new_value, customer_facing) VALUES (:runId, :sku, 'DELISTED', 'productStatus', 'ACTIVE', 'DELISTED', TRUE)

logger.doc:name: Log No Delisting Needed
logger.message: #['No products to delist for RunId=' ++ vars.runId]

db:select.doc:name: Aggregate History Counts
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN change_type = 'NEW' THEN sku END) AS new_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN change_type IN ('CHANGED_CUSTOMER_FACING','CHANGED_INTERNAL_ONLY') THEN sku END) AS changed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN change_type = 'HOLD_FOR_REVIEW' THEN sku END) AS held_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN change_type = 'DELISTED' THEN sku END) AS delisted_count FROM product_change_history WHERE run_id = :runId

db:select.doc:name: Aggregate Invalidation Counts
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalidation_requests, COALESCE(SUM(path_count), 0) AS invalidation_paths, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = FALSE THEN path_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unconfirmed_paths FROM cdn_invalidations WHERE run_id = :runId

db:select.doc:name: Fetch Parsed and Rejected Counts
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COALESCE(parsed_count, 0) AS parsed_count, COALESCE(rejected_count, 0) AS rejected_count FROM catalog_import_runs WHERE run_id = :runId

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var parsed = (vars.parsedRow[0].parsed_count default 0) as Number var rejected = (vars.parsedRow[0].rejected_count default 0) as Number var newC = (vars.runMetrics[0].new_count default 0) as Number var changed = (vars.runMetrics[0].changed_count default 0) as Number var held = (vars.runMetrics[0].held_count default 0) as Number var unchanged = (if ((parsed - newC - changed - held - rejected) > 0) (parsed - newC - changed - held - rejected) else 0) as Number --- { parsedCount: parsed, rejectedCount: rejected, unchangedCount: unchanged }

db:update.doc:name: Finalize Run Record â€” All Audit Columns
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE catalog_import_runs SET new_count = :newCount, changed_count = :changedCount, held_count = :heldCount, delisted_count = :delistedCount, parsed_count = :parsedCount, unchanged_count = :unchangedCount, rejected_count = :rejectedCount, invalidation_requests = :invRequests, invalidation_paths = :invPaths, unconfirmed_paths = :unconfirmedPaths, run_status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = :runId
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ runId: vars.runId, newCount: vars.runMetrics[0].new_count default 0, changedCount: vars.runMetrics[0].changed_count default 0, heldCount: vars.runMetrics[0].held_count default 0, delistedCount: vars.runMetrics[0].delisted_count default 0, parsedCount: vars.derivedCounts.parsedCount, unchangedCount: vars.derivedCounts.unchangedCount, rejectedCount: vars.derivedCounts.rejectedCount, invRequests: vars.invMetrics[0].invalidation_requests default 0, invPaths: vars.invMetrics[0].invalidation_paths default 0, unconfirmedPaths: vars.invMetrics[0].unconfirmed_paths default 0 }]

logger.doc:name: Log Run Finalized
logger.message: #['RUN_COMPLETED RunId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' | Parsed=' ++ vars.derivedCounts.parsedCount ++ ' New=' ++ (vars.runMetrics[0].new_count default 0) ++ ' Changed=' ++ (vars.runMetrics[0].changed_count default 0) ++ ' Unchanged=' ++ vars.derivedCounts.unchangedCount ++ ' Held=' ++ (vars.runMetrics[0].held_count default 0) ++ ' Rejected=' ++ vars.derivedCounts.rejectedCount ++ ' Delisted=' ++ (vars.runMetrics[0].delisted_count default 0) ++ ' InvReqs=' ++ (vars.invMetrics[0].invalidation_requests default 0) ++ ' InvPaths=' ++ (vars.invMetrics[0].invalidation_paths default 0) ++ ' Unconfirmed=' ++ (vars.invMetrics[0].unconfirmed_paths default 0)]

logger.doc:name: Alert High Change Volume
logger.message: #['ALERT_HIGH_CHANGE_VOLUME RunId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' â€” ' ++ (vars.runMetrics[0].changed_count default 0) ++ '/' ++ vars.derivedCounts.parsedCount ++ ' records changed (>80%). Likely a hash or formatting issue.']

logger.doc:name: Alert Unconfirmed Invalidations
logger.message: #['ALERT_UNCONFIRMED_INVALIDATIONS RunId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' â€” ' ++ (vars.invMetrics[0].unconfirmed_paths default 0) ++ ' path(s) unconfirmed. Stale CDN content possible.']
